title: Sr. Proposal Specialist
desc:
Founded in 2004, YEO is one of Türkiye’s leading companies providing engineering, technology, manufacturing, and renewable energy solutions for the energy sector. Covering the entire electrification value chain, we deliver end-to-end services in power generation, transmission, distribution, and efficient energy management.
With our strong production infrastructure and engineering expertise, we offer design, engineering, manufacturing, installation, operation, and maintenance services in solar and wind power plants, biogas and biomass facilities, floating solar plants, energy storage systems (BESS), and digital energy technologies. We also create added value with our expertise in high-voltage substations, power grids, hydrogen solutions, as well as transportation and infrastructure projects.
Through our REAP factory in Tuzla, we are expanding our capabilities in energy storage production and strengthening our vertical integration from EPC to BESS manufacturing.
To date, we have successfully completed over 400 projects in more than 40 countries. Among our 700+ employees, more than 200 are engineers and nearly 100 are women. With our headquarters, field operations, and robust manufacturing facilities, we contribute to sustainability goals both in Türkiye and in international markets.
Currently we are seeking a highly skilled
"Sr. Proposal Specialist"
to join our team.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Civil, Electrical, Electrical-Electronics Engineering, or a related field
Preferably, a minimum of 5 years of experience in proposal/tender preparation for substation, solar, BESS, or construction/EPC projects
Advanced MS Office proficiency (especially Excel)
Strong English communication skills, written and verbal
Result-oriented mindset with strong analytical thinking
Excellent team player with strong interpersonal and solution-oriented skills
Strong time management, organizational skills, and ability to work under pressure
Proactive, self-driven, with a patient and diplomatic approach to problem-solving
Job Description
Prepare cost analyses and cost estimations for solar, BESS, substation, and construction/EPC projects, benchmarking against comparable past projects
Prepare project drawings and technical layouts supporting proposals
Review inputs from business developers and provide project-related information and reports
Share proposal and cost reports with management
Track industry innovations and emerging trends in solar, BESS, and construction/EPC
Deliver assigned tasks on time, optimizing for labor, time, and material efficiency
